== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1087]] is assessed at 74% (probable). FamilySearch indexes Margreat Glassgow, 22 December 1643, with father William under Kirknewton and East Calder. William-1087’s 1609 Mid Calder birth gives an ordinary paternal age for the 1643 event and matches the later local William child cluster. The 2453 adult account has already been merged into this selected profile.

Probable childhood-to-adult identification, not a literal birth-to-father bridge. The father-only record and Kirknewton/Mid Calder parish presentation remain qualified.

Next useful test: Compare original residences and witnesses across the 1643 and 1648 family entries.
